newsitem.title: USA: N.J. economic activity index unchanged in February.
newsitem.headline: N.J. economic activity index unchanged in February.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia said Wednesday its New Jersey Economic Activity Index was unchanged in February.
Payroll employment was essentially flat, and the decrease in the unemployment rate was offset by a decline in average hours worked in manufacturing, the bank said.
For the 12 months ending in February, New Jersey's index was up 2.9 percent.
The national Index of Coincident Indicators compiled by the Conference Board rose 0.4 percent in February and was up 3.3 percent over the last 12 months.
The Economic Activity Index for New Jersey is constructed from three monthly data series -- payroll employment, average hours worked in manufacturing, and the unemployment rate.
